annotations.title: One inbox for comments, replies, mentions, reviews and DMs

description: Use this when the user asks for their unanswered comments, messages or reviews. EVERYTHING PEOPLE SAID TO THIS BRAND, across every connected channel, in one list: Facebook and Instagram comments, Threads replies and mentions, YouTube comments, Google Business reviews, Bluesky replies and mentions, and X mentions — plus DIRECT MESSAGES on Meta (Messenger and Instagram Direct), Instagram, Bluesky, X and Telegram. Support tickets too: the open conversations in the brand's Intercom inbox. Use this for 'what do I need to reply to', 'any new comments', 'any new DMs', 'how are people responding'. Each item carries a composite id you hand straight to reply_to_inbox_item. A channel that is not connected is skipped silently; a channel that FAILS to read is named in `notes` rather than dropped, so a short list is never mistaken for a quiet week. Each DM conversation folds to ONE item (the newest thing the other person said). Messenger and Instagram DMs need no argument; each has a messageKind (text, story_mention, story_reply, share, image, video...), a spoken summary, and unavailable:true when Meta withholds the content. Bluesky and X DMs need conversationId (list_bluesky_convos / list_x_dms). FREE ON EVERY CHANNEL EXCEPT X, which bills per API call — X mentions and X DMs cost credits per item returned, and every other source only re-reads what the per-channel tools already read.

conversationId.description: Restrict DMs to one conversation (from list_meta_conversations, list_bluesky_convos or list_x_dms). Required for Bluesky and X DMs; on X reading one costs credits.

pageId.description: Facebook Page id (list_meta_pages) when the brand has several Pages connected: reads that Page's Messenger and Instagram DMs and comments only. Omit to read every connected Page.

postId.description: Restrict Facebook/Instagram to one post or media id (Meta reads comments per post).

sources.description: Limit to these sources: facebook, instagram, threads, meta_dm, instagram_dm, meta_webhook, threads_mention, youtube, google_business, x, bluesky, bluesky_mention, bluesky_dm, x_dm, telegram_dm, intercom. Omit for every connected channel.

unansweredOnly.description: Only items with no reply from the brand yet.
